description: This file defines the ChargeToGLAccountMapper class, which serves as a data transfer object (DTO) mapping charges to general ledger accounts within the Fineract project. It includes fields for charge data and the associated GL account, and utilizes Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction.

classes.name: ChargeToGLAccountMapper
classes.description: A serializable data object that links a charge with a GL account, used within the accounting product to account mapping context.

methods.description: Generated constructor that initializes the object with required charge and GL account data.
